ADV-9 kept: the R2 rewrites catch the old class-pin mutations for flex-wrap, min-w-0, and the hero gradient (recorded at 8f7d94961).
ADV-10 kept: the merged rules name offenders and empty discovery fails loudly (recorded at 8f7d94961).

ADV-11 closed: 88b26fb9b flags any name with a case-insensitive .md suffix that is not exactly .md, plus .mdx, .markdown, other extensions, and none; my temporary th/ZZ-ADV-UPPER.MD failed three cases and was named in each.
ADV-12 note: the -segments.json allowance is by design; a post hidden behind that name escapes every rule, and a post behind .json never reaches production.
ADV-13 note: the file sweep reads one level per locale directory; a post in a nested subfolder would escape, but the blog pipeline never writes one and the shipped blog lib also reads one level.
ADV-14 note: the suffix checks are ASCII; a fullwidth or lookalike extension (for example a fullwidth .ｍｄ) would not match, which is a theoretical edge only.
